stations.label: Stations
stations.description: One station per line. Each station appears as a virtual MA player with its own queue, served on its own HTTP URL. The URL is shown on each station's player settings page. Renaming a station changes its URL and creates a new player.

disabled_reasons.lossless_uncompressed: A station always streams MP3, so any listener can tune in at any moment.
disabled_reasons.lossless_compressed: A station always streams MP3, so any listener can tune in at any moment.

errors.source_not_supported: {0} can only broadcast what is played from its Music Assistant queue. Anything else, such as Spotify Connect or an announcement, is not supported.
